title: Vault Orientation
definition: The practice of consulting the CADMIES knowledge system before beginning work to ensure alignment with the project's history, roadmap, and guidelines.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Starting every session by checking the project's notes, roadmap, and rules to stay updated and work effectively.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Consulting the CADMIES knowledge system for project context, decisions, and automation details to maintain consistency and alignment.
difficulty_levels.expert: Establishing a disciplined approach to orient before building, ensuring the project's continuity, integrity, and adaptability by leveraging the CADMIES system.

extra_fields.insight: The importance of consulting the CADMIES knowledge system before beginning work to maintain project consistency and alignment.
